This infrastructure is used to measure AWS service performance, conducting comprehensive analyses that drive critical business decisions at the CEO/SVP level and help guide teams in delivering the best cloud services in the industry. The primary deliverables are the infrastructure and automation required to accelerate, simplify, and make efficient deep-dive performance dashboards that identify recommendations to influence product direction across multiple AWS services.

Experience or strong interest in building agentic AI systems, including autonomous troubleshooting agents, LLM-driven infrastructure provisioning, and intelligent automation for operational workflows would be ideal. **Job Title: Computer Vision Engineer Terminal Guidance (EO/IR)**

**Location: Bengaluru / Bangalore (KIADB Aerospace Park, Devanahalli)**

**Experience: 1 – 2 Years**

**Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent**

**Industry: Aerospace & Defence / Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV)**

  

**About the Opportunity:**

  

We are hiring on behalf of our client, Green Aero Propulsion (Bengaluru), a pioneering aerospace and defence technology company. You will join the core perception team developing the EO/IR-based Terminal Guidance Pipeline for AgniPankh—an indigenous, transonic unmanned strike platform engineered to operate autonomously in GPS-denied environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Design, train, and optimize deep-learning models for real-time object detection, recognition, and multi-target tracking under strict Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) constraints.
* Develop robust computer vision algorithms capable of handling complex aerial/UAV challenges, including oblique viewing angles, rapid scale changes, motion blur, and low-contrast Infrared (IR) scenes.
* Implement multi-sensor fusion pipelines combining Electro-Optical (EO), Infrared (IR), and Inertial Navigation System (INS) data using Kalman / Extended Kalman Filters (EKF) and Particle Filters.
* Perform camera calibration, lens distortion correction, homography estimation, and multi-spectral (EO-to-IR) image registration.
* Integrate perception nodes into UAV/robotic software architectures using ROS / ROS 2 in a Linux/Docker environment.
* Support edge deployment and closed-loop simulation testing to validate targeting accuracy and low-latency inference.

  

**Mandatory Qualifications & Skills:**

  

* Education: B.Tech / M.Tech / Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline with a strong focus on Computer Vision.
* Experience: 1+ years of hands-on experience in object detection, recognition, and tracking using deep-learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent).
* Domain Experience: Demonstrated work on aerial/UAV imagery or thermal/IR datasets (handling scale variation, motion blur, and low contrast).
* Programming & DevOps: Strong coding proficiency in Python and C/C++; hands-on familiarity with Linux, Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Computer Vision Fundamentals: Solid understanding of camera models, lens distortion, homographies, and multi-spectral image registration.
* Sensor Fusion & Middleware: Familiarity with sensor-fusion concepts (EO + IR + INS), Kalman/EKF/Particle-filter tracking, and working knowledge of ROS / ROS 2.
* Eligibility: Must be an Indian Citizen capable of obtaining necessary security clearances for defence projects.

  
  

**Good-to-Have / Preferred Skills:**

  

* Prior experience in defence, missile guidance, or loitering-munition vision systems.
* Hands-on experience deploying models on embedded edge hardware (NVIDIA Jetson, Intel Movidius, Xilinx/AMD FPGA) using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, quantization (INT8/FP16), pruning, or knowledge distillation.
* Proficiency with simulation environments (AirSim, Gazebo, or FlightGear) for vision-in-the-loop testing.
* Familiarity with scene-matching algorithms (TERCOM, DSMAC), SAR/mmWave radar image processing, or GAN/diffusion-based synthetic data generation.
* Exposure to MIL-STD or DO-178C/DO-254 certification processes, or published research/patents in aerial object detection, visual SLAM, or safety-critical vision systems.
